title: The Serpent Jewels
translation: The tawny glow of the jewels on the hoods of the serpents in his locks paints the faces of the brides of the directions, as if with liquid saffron. He wears the shining hide of a maddened elephant as his upper cloth. May my mind hold a wonderful joy in him, the lord of all beings.
translation_hi: जिनकी जटाओं के सर्पों के चमकते फणों की मणियों की पीली आभा दिशा रूपी वधुओं के मुख पर केसर के लेप जैसी लगती है, और जो मदमस्त हाथी की चमकती खाल को उत्तरीय की तरह ओढ़ते हैं, उन भूतनाथ शिव में मेरा मन अद्भुत आनंद पाए।

words.note: drava = liquid. Hindi द्रव; द्रव यांत्रिकी = fluid mechanics.

words.meaning: on the faces of the brides of the directions
words.note: The directions imagined as brides. Locative.
Hindi त्वचा. Becomes त्वग् before a vowel.

grammar: Reduplication: some roots double their first syllable in the present: √भृ → बिभर्ति (bears), imperative बिभर्तु. Compare √दा → ददाति (gives).
Agent nouns in -tri: भर्तृ 'supporter' (from √bhri), like कर्तृ (doer) and दातृ (giver). Locative: भर्तरि.
Science word: द्रव 'liquid' is the Hindi word for fluid in physics: द्रव यांत्रिकी = fluid mechanics.
